messages:
Alex: Quick sync — PR #7124 (db-shard-migration) is blocking tonight's cutover. We need 2 approvals before the 22:00 PT cutoff to include it in the midnight job. Schema-owner hasn't signed off yet, and one integration test is flaky.
Maya: On it — what's flaky? failing test name?
Alex: `tests/integration/test_shard_rebalance.py::test_rebalance_timeout` times out on the last step. CI shows 1x failure, rerun passed for me locally. Logs:
```
TimeoutError: Rebalance did not finish within 300s
Node 3: hung waiting on compaction
```
Maya: hmm, could be infra flake. Can we rerun CI and ask infra to look if it's persistent?
Alex: I just re-ran; CI is green now. Still need schema-owner approval (@Jordan) and one other LGTM.
Jordan: pinged. I'll take a look in 15 after stand. quick skim: schema changes look fine but need to confirm migrations are idempotent.
Sam: I can do the second review after the demo at 16:30 PT. If you need faster, Jordan, feel free to ping me.
release-bot: reminder — merge cutoff at 22:00 PT. 2 approvals required for PRs tagged `cutover/midnight-2026-03-18`.
Maya: I'll do a focused pass on the migration idempotency now. If it's small, can give LGTM.
Maya: LGTM on migration idempotency. left one tiny nit about comment on `migrate_shard()` but not blocking :thumbsup:
Jordan: looked through migrations, ran locally with `--dry-run`, no stateful side effects. LGTM from schema side. leaving note: consider backfill plan in docs.
Alex: Amazing — that gives us 2x approvals. I'll merge after the 22:00 PT cutoff window closes and coordinate cutover. Thanks all, will file a post-cutover note.
Sam: :party_parrot: good job team!
